description: This file defines the 'PlaceholderFunctionTooComplexException' class, a custom unchecked runtime exception used within the Eclipse Ditto project's placeholders package. It indicates that placeholder functions are too complex (e.g., too many chained functions) to be safely processed by the backend, and provides methods for creating, serializing, and deserializing instances of this exception.

classes.name: PlaceholderFunctionTooComplexException
classes.description: A final class extending DittoRuntimeException, representing an exception thrown when placeholder functions are too complex for backend processing.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for the exception, pre-populated with default message and a description based on maximum allowed chained functions.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON object into an instance of PlaceholderFunctionTooComplexException using provided JSON and headers.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Returns a mutable builder pre-populated with current exception data; deprecated.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new exception instance with updated Ditto headers.
